punchline: Marie Kondo spent years searching for things to throw away, and her home only came together once she started asking what to keep.
thirty_sec: As a teenager, Marie Kondo tidied by discarding, hunting every afternoon after school for things to throw out, and it wore her out. By her own account, a breakdown made her see that she had been asking the wrong question. She began holding each item in her hands and asking whether to keep it. That became her test: does it spark joy?
